HANDOFFS

    seed_note({seed: "<id>", text: "…", handoff: true})   for the next tender. `seed_tend` prints the
                                           handoff on the claim. `seed_show` lists it
    seed_standby({seed: "<id>", next: "…"})          close your session until the seed gets mail.
                                           `at` sets a reminder too; `stay` keeps you open.
                                           To wait on the user, ask with `ask`
    seed_show({seed: "<id>"})   prints the seed and its newest entries,
                           which `seed_notes` lists whole; `since` skips the old ones
